lawsInPlay.name: Checks and Balances
lawsInPlay.text1: For: When a player chooses a strategy card during the strategy phase, they give that strategy card to another player who does not have 1 (or a player who does not have 2 in a three- or four-player game), if able.
lawsInPlay.text2: Against: Each player readies only 3 of their planets at the end of this agenda phase.
lawsInPlay.mapText: When a player chooses a strategy card during the strategy phase, they give that strategy card to another player who does not have 1 (2 in 3p and 4p games), if able.

lawsInPlay.name: Minister of Exploration
lawsInPlay.text1: The elected player gains this card. When the owner of this card gains control of a planet, they gain 1 trade good.
lawsInPlay.mapText: When you gain control of a planet, you gain 1 trade good.

lawsInPlay.name: Minister of Industry
lawsInPlay.text1: The elected player gains this card. When the owner of this card places a space dock in a system, their units in that system may use their PRODUCTION abilities.
lawsInPlay.mapText: When you place a space dock in a system, your units in that system may use their PRODUCTION abilities.
